reason: jest-runtime gates the new order on vm.SourceTextModule.prototype.hasAsyncGraph (Node 24.9+), which is undefined on the Node 22 the benchmark runs, so the old linking-time order is all that can be exercised.
Only the package bin (`openai migrate`, a one-off codemod CLI) is removed and openai 7.34.0 has no bin field; no TypeScript code an agent writes can import or depend on it.
Logging only: dotenv 18.0.8 ends the injected-env console message after the file list, and no application code depends on the random tip text the message used to carry.
Only the optional nodemailer peer range is raised (^6.6.5 to ^7.0.7) with no change to the next-auth EmailProvider API; nodemailer is not in the template and a peer range cannot make agent code fail.

Tried res.type()/res.set() with boundary, header, profile and custom parameters before res.send() on express 5.1.0 and 5.3.0: 5.1.0 also kept every parameter (the entry is wrong that it dropped them), so the only difference is parameter order, which HTTP treats as insignificant and no application code depends on.

Tried multi-provider setups (two providers for one IdP, a redirect_uri pointed at another provider, renamed provider ids): in every working flow the state/nonce/PKCE cookie is minted and consumed by the same provider, so the new check only rejects forged or cross-provider callbacks and sign-ins in flight during the upgrade, which no application code relies on.

Behavior on malformed input only: considered API routes that map getToken() results to 401/400, but the usual null check already gives a correct result on 4.24.15, and code that depends on the old URIError from a badly percent-encoded Bearer value would be relying on an undocumented crash.
